steps.js: (async()=>{const rolagem=(el)=>{let c=el&&el.parentElement;while(c&&c!==document.body){const s=getComputedStyle(c);if(/(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowY)&&c.scrollHeight>c.clientHeight+4)return c;c=c.parentElement;}return null};const el=[...document.querySelectorAll("[role=dialog] *")].filter(e=>e.textContent.trim()==="A Pagar"&&e.offsetParent).sort((a,b)=>a.textContent.length-b.textContent.length||a.children.length-b.children.length)[0];if(!el)return 'SEM ALVO';const c=rolagem(el);if(!c)return 'SEM ROLAGEM';let dy=Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top-150);const y0=c.scrollTop;dy=Math.max(-y0,Math.min(c.scrollHeight-c.clientHeight-y0,dy));if(Math.abs(dy)<3)return 'ok';await new Promise(res=>{const t0=performance.now();const f=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/800),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;c.scrollTop=y0+dy*e;p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top)})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const esp=[["Fundição Bandeira do Vale", "verde"], ["Aços Quiririm Ltda", "verde"], ["Valdir Pereira", "verde"], ["Cooperativa Recomeço", "vermelho"], ["Depósito Irmãos Siqueira", "vermelho"], ["Serra Fina Alumínio Reciclagem", "vermelho"]];const cor=e=>{for(const el of [e,...e.querySelectorAll('*')])for(const p of ['color','backgroundColor']){const m=(getComputedStyle(el)[p].match(/[\d.]+/g)||[]).map(Number);if(m.length<3||(m.length>3&&m[3]===0))continue;const [r,g]=m;if(g>r+40)return 'verde';if(r>g+40)return 'vermelho'}return 'cinza'};let out=[],ok=true;for(const [n,c] of esp){const tr=[...document.querySelectorAll("[role=dialog]"+' tr')].find(t=>t.textContent.includes(n));const el=tr&&tr.querySelector("td:nth-child(3)");if(!el){out.push(n+': SEM ALVO');ok=false;continue}const k=cor(el);if(k!==c)ok=false;out.push(n.split(' ')[0]+' '+el.textContent.trim()+' '+k)}return (ok?'OK: ':'DIFERENTE: ')+out.join(' | ')})()
